title: Knowledge Gateway MCP — ProviderCapabilities Descriptor
description: Phase 0 contract-only, shape definition per docs/plans/knowledge-gateway-mcp-proposal.md §8.1. Populated instances live in sibling provider_capabilities_context_search.json and provider_capabilities_graphify.json. The router must never claim a capability a descriptor does not advertise — see knowledge_gateway_mcp_contract.md's capability_allows() contract.

adapter_version.description: null is the honest value when no adapter code exists yet to report a version — see Design Decision D1 in the plan for why this is not left as a made-up string.

generation_fingerprint.description: Optional per §8.1's own annotation on this field.
